method_feasibility.ECAT_model: Implemented as simplified SPM with thermal coupling and SEI aging
method_feasibility.ANN_meta_model: Fully implemented via PyTorch (MLP with BatchNorm)
method_feasibility.Genetic_Algorithm: Fully implemented with tournament selection, BLX-alpha crossover, adaptive mutation
method_feasibility.MMGA_framework: Complete pipeline: LHS -> ECAT sim -> ANN training -> GA optimization

limitations: ECAT model is simplified SPM, not full P2D
Solid-phase diffusion not fully resolved (uses average SOC)
Oxford dynamic validation has higher error due to simplified current handling
Direct GA comparison uses smaller population for practical timing
